body.text: on january 1, 2026, i opened my notebook and wrote one sentence at the top of the page.
year of the horse + year one.
underneath it, i wrote the energy i wanted the year to carry.
movement. new beginnings. alignment. freedom. a return to truth. beauty. passion. flow. power. opportunity.
i knew i needed something cleaner from my life.
before the year ended, i had already made a decision that required me to choose clarity over comfort.
and that wasn’t easy.
i had to say what needed to be said and do what needed to be done.
then i had to sit with the discomfort that came after.
i kept reminding myself not to second-guess the decision just because it felt uncomfortable.
discomfort doesn’t mean i was wrong. sometimes it means i was honest.
i didn’t reject. i honored my boundary.
that distinction matters to me.
a boundary is not always anger. it is not always punishment. sometimes it is the clearest way to tell the truth about what u can no longer carry.
that was what i needed going into 2026.
i could no longer be available for confusion.
for emotional guessing.
for half-aligned connections that required me to keep explaining what should have already been clear.
me in 2026 meant clarity, honesty + emotional simplicity.
that meant paying attention to what a connection asked me to become.
when something feels heavy or requires constant explaining, that is my cue.
not to keep fixing it.
not to force understanding.
to step back.
alignment should feel natural, not negotiated.
natural does not mean perfect.
it means both people can be honest without turning every feeling, expectation or boundary into a debate.
moving forward, i’m choosing connections that meet me fully.
connections with clear communication.
connections that allow me to stay in my own energy without shrinking or distancing myself just to keep the peace.
i’m not asking every connection to be easy.
i am asking it to be honest.
clarity is not cold.
clarity is respect.
it gives everybody involved the chance to make decisions from what is real instead of what they are hoping will eventually become real.
i’m writing this because i want to get more personal about my life.
i share a lot of ideas, observations + lessons.
but there is also a person behind those ideas.
a person making decisions, setting boundaries, questioning himself, learning from discomfort + trying to move with more intention.
some of that story lives in private notebook pages before it ever becomes something i’m ready to say out loud.
this is one of those pages.
movement. new beginnings. alignment. freedom. a return to truth.
that is still the energy.
clarity is the standard now.
